dedupe_keys.name: tceq industrial and hazardous waste notice of registration nor data texas waste generating and managing sites

description: Registration data for every site in Texas that generates, stores, treats or disposes of industrial or hazardous (solid) waste. The TCEQ page says the data refresh daily and can be queried and downloaded as separate files: facilities (registration number and type, company, mailing address, site location and notification details), owners and operators, primary site and billing contacts, wastes generated at each site with Texas waste codes, waste management units with their unit types, universal waste activity and episodic generation. Waste and unit records link to sites by registration number, and the TCEQ raw data page also points to IHW summary datasets on the Texas Open Data Portal with annual waste summaries. The files are free and downloadable; the licence and file format are not stated on the page read. Coverage is the State of Texas, one row per registered site. Caveats: site locations are given as addresses and notification details, not checked coordinates, and contact fields hold personal data. For simulation it locates chemical plants, refineries and waste units with the wastes they hold, to estimate hazardous material releases when a hurricane, flood or power loss hits the Gulf Coast industrial corridor. A related catalogue record is the EPA Facility Registry Service.
